title: What if the Sun swelled into a red giant? ☀️
subject: sun
description:
Do you think Earth makes it? 👇

In about 5 billion years the Sun runs out of core hydrogen and swells into a red giant. NASA says it will swallow Mercury and Venus, and possibly Earth. A 2008 study said Earth can't escape; a June 2026 study from KU Leuven says it probably can.

Sources: NASA Science, "Sun: Facts"; Schröder & Smith, "Distant future of the Sun and Earth revisited," MNRAS 386, 155 (2008); Esseldeurs, Mathis & Decin, "The fate of Earth during the Sun's giant phases," Astronomy & Astrophysics 710, L26 (June 2026); Space.com, "Earth may survive the sun's death after all" (July 8, 2026); Wikipedia, "Future of Earth".

scenes.text: Your oceans will boil away long before the Sun dies.
In about 1 billion years, the Sun will shine 10% brighter, and Earth's seas will evaporate.
About 4 billion years after that, its core runs out of hydrogen and it swells into a red giant.
NASA says it will swallow Mercury and Venus, and possibly Earth.
A 2008 study said Earth can't escape. A June 2026 model from KU Leuven has Earth drifting outward and surviving.
Even they admit Earth's final fate is still uncertain.
